reply.summary: Lertes is a former crimefighter whose body was overwritten by a hostile machine mind and rebuilt as a gleaming chrome copy of herself. Lertes now stalks her old allies through their own cave hideout.

feats.scene: Lertes smashes a steel workbench in half with a servo-driven fist.
Lertes takes a rocket-propelled grenade to the chest plate and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Resnte is a black-haired frontier rider who policed the countryside from horseback long ago. Resnte was later honoured with a painting in a hall of old heroes.

feats.scene: Resnte leaps from the saddle and tackles a fleeing bandit into the dust.
Resnte is thrown from her galloping mount and rolls up unhurt.

reply.summary: Seoraveo is a soldier from a distant future who jumps backward through time to hunt a famous runner, then switches sides. Seoraveo built a device that lets others skip along the timeline and she vanishes automatically when exhausted.

feats.scene: Seoraveo hurls herself into a blinking sprint and shoves two trucks off a blast radius.
Seoraveo is pounded by an angry speedster until her body flickers away to safety.

reply.summary: Lannolse is a young black-haired adventurer from a rainy northern port city who joined a team of explorers. Lannolse has no known gifts beyond nerve and loyalty.

feats.scene: Lannolse hauls on a rope to drag a teammate from a pit.
Lannolse tumbles down a cave slope and comes up scraped and grinning.

reply.summary: Eolllte is a patient wife whose preacher husband crosses a local drug lord, putting both their lives at risk. Eolllte lives in constant fear, relying on a hired stand-in to take the heat.

feats.scene: Eolllte slams the car door and drives her son away from the danger.
Eolllte is knocked down by a panicked crowd and stands back up shaking.

reply.summary: Cosiia is a red-haired television journalist who slants her broadcasts to flatter a sinister cult and smear young heroes. Cosiia later hosts a show carrying her own name.

feats.scene: Cosiia throws her microphone across the studio in a rage.
Cosiia is jostled in a street riot and keeps talking to camera.

reply.summary: Tisteiu is a pale, grey-eyed engineered monster whose astral self drifts free of her grotesque body in search of psychic fuel. Tisteiu drinks energy and steals powers from the gifted, turning her skin to razor-sharp glass or crystal at will.

feats.scene: Tisteiu releases a stolen blaze that burns a lab wing to ash.
Tisteiu hardens into crystal and shrugs off a barrage of heavy fire.

reply.summary: Llulecor is a hard-bitten defence lawyer of the early twentieth century who bends the rules in court and carries a hidden pistol. Llulecor can shoot a gun out of a hand from across a room.

feats.scene: Llulecor fires once across a crowded courtroom and the killer's weapon spins away.
Llulecor takes a shove through a glass partition and walks out unfazed.

reply.summary: Titirno is a small-town girl who witnesses a gangland killing, testifies, and is given a new name and hypnotic suggestions to bury the trauma. Titirno later falls in love with a neighbour who resembles her old boss.

feats.scene: Titirno slaps a would-be attacker hard across the face.
Titirno is knocked flat in a stairwell struggle and rises shaking.

reply.summary: Aninorre is a dark mirror of a futuristic bat-masked hero, recruited by a sinister laughing overlord to join a conquering band of twisted heroes. Aninorre is dissolved the moment his master no longer needs him.

feats.scene: Aninorre blasts a guard tower to rubble with a shoulder cannon.
Aninorre drops through a collapsing fortress floor and lands upright in the smoke.

reply.summary: Iarvase is a brown-eyed warrior reborn at a sacred spring who glimpses events before they happen and serves as an oracle. Iarvase discovered her gift in a trial of spinning spheres, impressing the scribes.

feats.scene: Iarvase hurls a training spear through a bronze shield before the target even moves.
Iarvase steps out of a rockfall seconds before it lands.

reply.summary: Semirn is a black-haired girl grown in a laboratory as a replica of her adoptive parent's mother, with false memories fed to her by a drug. Semirn works as a gifted young scientist at a vast company.

feats.scene: Semirn sweeps a tray of instruments off a bench in frustration.
Semirn slips on a wet lab floor and bounces up.

reply.summary: Ialtiu is a bald, cheerful spice trader and innkeeper in a medieval town of stone towers. Ialtiu serves every traveller a hot meal and a rumour.

feats.scene: Ialtiu hefts a barrel of cloves onto the counter without a grunt.
Ialtiu is shoved over a bench in a tavern scuffle and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Rornueo is a big, clumsy young man who took up skin diving to improve himself and ended up a master swimmer. Rornueo hunts sunken treasure with a trio of friends beneath the waves.

feats.scene: Rornueo wrestles a stuck anchor free from a wreck and hauls it up.
Rornueo endures a deep descent and a brawl with a reef monster.

reply.summary: Lanrent is a red-haired former big-top clown who traded the circus for life as a masked crimefighter's sidekick. Lanrent boxes well and drives a mean getaway.

feats.scene: Lanrent lands a jab that sends a thug through a barrel stack.
Lanrent skids a car into a lamp post and steps out with a grin.

reply.summary: Mirni is a flashy young hero with a gadget harness that fires bursts, scans surroundings, and projects holograms for meetings. Mirni joined a team mostly to chase fame and the heart of a teammate.

feats.scene: Mirni fires a harness blast that shreds a parked van into scrap.
Mirni is thrown from a speeding wagon and bounces to his feet.

reply.summary: Saesium is a black-furred, red-eyed storybook predator who disguises himself as a kindly elder and hunts for a cruel queen. Saesium slashes with claws and bites with fangs.

feats.scene: Saesium rakes his claws through a barn door and the planks fly apart.
Saesium takes a crossbow bolt in the flank and keeps running.

reply.summary: Oleri is a blue-eyed divine warrior from a bright sky-city who loves his wife and settles quarrels with a song. Oleri bears the endurance and strength of his people.

feats.scene: Oleri strikes a boulder-strewn hillside and the whole slope collapses.
Oleri walks out of a landslide humming a tune.

reply.summary: Rerluau is a black-haired, one-eyed sky pirate from a fiery planet who sails with a crew of fierce women. Rerluau takes what she wants and fears nobody.

feats.scene: Rerluau rips the door off a freighter hold with her bare hands.
Rerluau stays upright after a cannon salvo shreds the deck around her.

reply.summary: Siramo is a towering warrior woman from a divine bloodline who left a fiery homeland for a bright sky-city. Siramo is agile, durable, and hits hard, and she carries a staff that fires energy beams.

feats.scene: Siramo fires her staff and a beam levels a row of warehouses.
Siramo laughs through a collapsing skyscraper floor.

reply.summary: Tirrus is a green-eyed, white-haired battlefield soldier chosen to bear the next generation of warriors, who loves an unapproved fighter and names her child for the battlefield. Tirrus fights with stealth, sword, and bare hands.

feats.scene: Tirrus swings her sword through a siege engine and it crumples.
Tirrus holds the front line through a barrage that scorches the field.

reply.summary: Sticis is a brown-haired masked poacher who follows in his dead father's footsteps hunting people for sport. Sticis hides his face and his name.

feats.scene: Sticis fires a heavy hunting rifle through a thick door.
Sticis falls from a jungle gantry and limps away.

reply.summary: Lentorser is a swaggering frontier outlaw who runs a gang from a dusty settlement. Lentorser mocks strangers by their looks and pays for it.

feats.scene: Lentorser fires his revolver and splinters a saloon post.
Lentorser takes a bar-stool to the back and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Iueonar is a storybook predator who walks as a man but is truly a great wolf, kept alive for centuries by a witch's bargain. Iueonar changes shape at will and grows in size, fangs, and claws when he does.

feats.scene: Iueonar swells into a huge wolf and tears a car roof off in one bite.
Iueonar walks out of a burning tenement with his coat singed.

reply.summary: Urntilau is a nimble street runner from a big river city who vaults roofs and railings to protect his neighbourhood. Urntilau joined a network of masked allies abroad.

feats.scene: Urntilau launches off a wall and drops a mugger with a flying kick.
Urntilau lands a long roof leap badly and rolls out of it.

reply.summary: Letarer is a descendant living a thousand years ahead who speaks a clipped version of an ancient word to become a champion, though it keeps him timid and earthbound. Letarer flies and fights bravely once he speaks the whole word.

feats.scene: Letarer shouts the full word and a bolt of lightning turns him into a giant who hurls a tank across a street.
Letarer endures a collapsing tower of glass and steel without a bruise.

reply.summary: Retau is a slick young executive who inherits a crime syndicate from his jailed father and tries to run it with a salesman's smile. Retau threatens anyone who refuses to work for him.

feats.scene: Retau slams his fist on a boardroom table to make a point.
Retau is tossed against a wall by a bodyguard and brushes off his suit.

reply.summary: Anenum is an aging grey-haired tycoon who hides a crime syndicate behind a chain of discount stores and charity galas. Anenum gets a heart transplant and a second chance, only to be betrayed by family.

feats.scene: Anenum bangs his cane on the desk and a clerk flinches.
Anenum survives surgery on a failing heart and returns to work.

reply.summary: Vassaule is a grey-haired, blue-eyed city detective who is competent with investigation and firearms but corrupt in the end. Vassaule meets a quick, grim fate during a balloon scheme.

feats.scene: Vassaule fires his service pistol and a lamp shatters.
Vassaule is shoved against a squad car and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Amnal is a grey-haired drag singer who was locked in an asylum by family, survived a brutal operation, and escaped to perform in underground bars. Amnal carved a lantern out of a strange glowing green ore for a friend.

feats.scene: Amnal chisels a lantern from a lump of green ore with a hammer and patience.
Amnal endures years of cruel treatment and walks out singing.

reply.summary: Amolon is a portly, red-haired boy from a big borough who shares a name with a radio star, and who becomes a mighty giant when he shouts an old word with his friends. Amolon helps defeat a scheming scientist.

feats.scene: Amolon shouts the word, becomes a hulking hero, and snaps a buzzsaw rig in half.
Amolon is struck by a lightning bolt and stands taller for it.

reply.summary: Llelenamo is a blond young man named for a famous hero who serves with two fellow lieutenants against a society of monsters. Llelenamo transforms into a flying, speedy, invulnerable adult by speaking an old word.

feats.scene: Llelenamo flies into a monster fortress and shatters its gates.
Llelenamo is buried under a collapsing dome and emerges laughing.
Llelenamo streaks above the rooftops faster than any jet.

reply.summary: Irnnau is a small piglet who shouts a silly word to swell into a hulking muscular hog, guarding a farm hall with his animal friends. Irnnau once sends a tyrant duck packing.

feats.scene: Irnnau bellows his word and tosses a barn door across the pasture.
Irnnau shrugs off a trough dropped from a loft.

reply.summary: Uncessor is a young radio operator on an expedition who is granted the gift of becoming a mighty protector by an ancient sage in a temple. Uncessor flies and hits hard until the threat is over, then returns to normal.

feats.scene: Uncessor leaps from the ruins and punches a stone idol to gravel.
Uncessor stands unhurt in a rain of bullets inside the temple.

reply.summary: Lesterte is a cheerful, fair-minded boy who calls down a lightning bolt to become a mighty flying hero with a thunderous touch. Lesterte briefly joined a famous league but left after seeing its heroes lose their ideals.

feats.scene: Lesterte gathers a thunderhead and throws a bolt that cracks a hillside.
Lesterte takes a clash with a stronger hero and rises, still polite.

reply.summary: Alllevor is an orphan from a coastal city whose guardian murdered his parents, and who is chosen by a sage to become a hero empowered by six legends. Alllevor works as a television reporter by day.

feats.scene: Alllevor says the sage's name and throws a lightning-wreathed punch through a bank vault.
Alllevor stands his ground in a battle with a cosmic warlord.

reply.summary: Minuam is an orphaned schoolboy who loves old comics about a hero with his own name and dreams he could be one. Minuam tries the magic word in front of a villain and nothing happens.

feats.scene: Minuam throws a schoolbag at a looming tyrant in a brave moment.
Minuam is grabbed and shaken like a rag doll and still shouts.

reply.summary: Cailri is a black-haired young man who takes up a fallen hero's costume to calm a nervous world, hiding behind a helmet. Cailri calls lightning to transform when forced to reveal himself.

feats.scene: Cailri calls down the bolt and a blast of lightning knocks a rampaging brute cold.
Cailri tears through his own costume and keeps flying unharmed.

reply.summary: Renol is a teen gamer pulled into duty by an old sage to fight a banished rival, calling on divine power when he shouts the sage's name. Renol is nearly at a new level in his video game when summoned.

feats.scene: Renol shouts the name, becomes a champion, and blasts a horde of ancient spirits across a canyon.
Renol takes a sorcerer's blast and shakes his head, annoyed.

reply.summary: Tesrnuser is a streetwise child radio host who becomes an adult hero with the courage, strength, and speed of mythical figures by shouting an old sage's name. Tesrnuser keeps a child's enthusiasm in an adult's body.

feats.scene: Tesrnuser flies into an orbiting station and hammers a drifting hull plate into dust.
Tesrnuser holds back a cave-in of rock and steel with one outstretched arm.
Tesrnuser races through the sky faster than a missile.

reply.summary: Siace is a television news reporter in the days of cartoon adventure who calls on the strength of legends when he shouts an elder's name. Siace is stuck as a mortal whenever his lightning is blocked or his voice silenced.

feats.scene: Siace turns into a hero and hurls a rampaging machine over a zoo wall.
Siace shrugs off a barrage from a villain's mirror weapon.

reply.summary: Llolli is a legendary caped hero known to children in a tiny cartoon city, whose poster hangs on an orphan's wall. Llolli carries the divine gift of mythic champions.

feats.scene: Llolli lifts a toy-sized bus above his head and sets it gently on a rooftop.
Llolli takes a falling building block on his shoulder without a flinch.

reply.summary: Iumauni is a hero who guards a mountain military refuge for a scheming president, using speed and great strength. Iumauni is eventually beaten by a stronger opponent.

feats.scene: Iumauni slams a hover-tank into the cliff face and cracks the ridge.
Iumauni is struck by a volley of missiles and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Ntema is a troubled young man in a crowded city who starts hearing a voice urging him to speak a certain name. Ntema resists until the voice threatens someone he loves.

feats.scene: Ntema pushes a stranger away from the platform edge in a panic.
Ntema collapses on the subway steps and drags himself upright.

reply.summary: Sancelri is a cartoonish schoolboy who shouts a wizard's name to gain super-strength, healing, memory, and flight, and who guides tiny friends to a magic home. Sancelri gives them a boulder as a replacement for their lost treehouse.

feats.scene: Sancelri hoists a giant boulder and sets it down in the clubhouse yard.
Sancelri bounces off a toy car crash without a scratch.

reply.summary: Numtite is a blond frontier gunslinger who rides out to avenge her murdered father, with a revolver and one of the quickest draws around. Numtite is secretly a girl in a world that expects a boy.

feats.scene: Numtite draws and fires before the outlaw's hand clears the holster.
Numtite takes a pistol-whipping in a saloon and gets up with her gun already cocked.

reply.summary: Telli is a washed-up pop singer who gets a second, grim life as a hulking reanimated brute, sent after his own brother. Telli had been chewed up and tossed aside by greedy executives.

feats.scene: Telli smashes a delivery truck into a wall with a stiff, hulking swing.
Telli takes a hunting spear through the chest and lurches on.

reply.summary: Vaser is a cartoon teen villain who splits his body into many copies of himself through cell division. Vaser is also a decent athlete and leaps into trouble with a crew of fellow miscreants.

feats.scene: Vaser splits into ten copies who all kick a gate at once.
Vaser is flattened by a mallet and peels himself off the floor.

reply.summary: Oreul is a brown-haired space bounty hunter who survives in vacuum, plays the drums, and throws a sharpened steel comb with deadly aim. Oreul wins bets, partners with brawlers, and fears few targets.

feats.scene: Oreul flings her steel comb and pins a smuggler's sleeve to a wall.
Oreul floats unharmed in hard vacuum for minutes after a hull breach.

reply.summary: Tirviamo is a bald machine-cyborg assembled by linked computers to study planetary decline, which decides humanity itself is the disease. Tirviamo builds a hidden base under the ice and flies with an army of droids of its own design.

feats.scene: Tirviamo bombards a ridge of glacier and brings an ice cliff down on a convoy.
Tirviamo's metal hull withstands a jet's missile strike in the polar sky.
